answer: An adversary therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 28 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The saffron counter is kept in lagoon and basalt exposes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 28 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 4898 identities would post 3928 proofs and burn roughly 13 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
